text:
Alertmanager: ALERT firing: SLO burn rate high for service=api-service (10m burn_rate=9.2) — severity=page. See /alerts
Maya R: saw the page from Alertmanager. Where do we surface the burn-rate calc for this SLO? also: is this against the 99.9% latency or the error SLO?
Sam T: the Grafana SLO dashboard has both. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/slo/slo-overview?var-service=api-service
Sam T: 10m burn rate of 9.2 indicates we're consuming error budget fast — open the "Burn rate (sliding)" panel.
Maya R: thanks. runbook link? do we have an ops playbook for temporary alert threshold changes so we don't flip-flop during deploys?
George L: runbook is here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sre/slo-runbook
George L: tl;dr: verify root cause, check for deploy, reduce alert severity to warning only if pre-approved by oncall/owner and add a 30m suppression.
Lee (SRE): saw increased 5xxs from /v1/generate around 12:41 UTC, likely correlated with a canary rollout. trace: https://tempo.redwood.internal/trace/abcd1234
Lee (SRE): also noticed a traffic spike from a single client IP; logs: https://loki.redwood.internal/loki/api/v1/query?query=%7Bservice%3D%22api-service%22%7D%20%7C%3D%20%22500%22
Maya R: is the SLA impacted? customer-facing SLA reports show uptime per month — where do we pull the current month status quickly?
Sam T: SLA report is auto-generated in the Console -> Compliance -> SLA Reports, link: https://console.redwood.internal/sla-reports?service=api-service
Maya R: I can patch alert thresholds in the alerting repo if we agree. propose changing the 10m burn threshold from 8 -> 12 for this SLO temporarily, and add a suppression for the canary window.
Maya R: example rule tweak (rough):
```
- alert: SloBurnRate_High_ApiService
  expr: slo:burn_rate:ratio{service="api-service",window="10m"} > 12
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
```
Sam T: FYI any change needs a small unit test in alerts/tests/ and a staging deploy. I can open a PR and run the staging alertcheck.
George L: please include an annotation linking to the runbook and the deploy ID. Approve the temporary relax if Sam posts the PR and I + oncall pair sign off.
Maya R: pinging @Alertmanager ? (cc @Sam T @George L) — I'll wait for the PR. If we suppress, add an expiry and manual rollback step.
Sam T: opening PR now; will include test and the suppression window. ETA 15m.
Lee (SRE): in parallel, I'm rolling back the canary for the affected route to reduce 5xxs.
Sam T: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerting/pull/512 — adds threshold bump + suppression + test. running alertcheck...
Alertmanager: silence created: silence_id=5a6b7c — expires in 30m (created by Sam T)
George L: thanks. once we confirm burn rate stabilizes, we'll close the silence and revert the temporary rule in a follow-up PR.
Maya R: good plan. can someone add a quick note in the incident tracker so product teams see this? ticket: INC-2026
Sam T: added note to INC-2026 with links and SLA impact estimate.
Maya R: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
